# R Packages

Ten packages, all on CRAN, all documented, all actively maintained. Each was
written while teaching at [Rsquared Academy](https://www.rsquaredacademy.com/)
and shared in the hope that others find them useful.

The goal is software which is user friendly, light weight, well tested and well
documented. Major bugs get fixed quickly; feature requests are considered but
not promised.

Full descriptions and vignettes: [pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com](https://pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com/).

## Regression and modelling

::: {.pkg}

![](../images/hex-olsrr.webp){.pkg-hex alt="olsrr hex sticker"}

### [olsrr](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com) {.pkg-name}

Tools for building linear regression models

- Comprehensive Regression Output
- Variable Selection Procedures
- Heteroskedasticity Tests
- Collinearity Diagnostics
- Model Fit Assessment
- Measures of Influence
- Residual Diagnostics

[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=olsrr) &nbsp; [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/olsrr) &nbsp; [Docs](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com)

:::

::: {.pkg}

![](../images/hex-blorr.webp){.pkg-hex alt="blorr hex sticker"}

## Archived

::: {.callout-warning}
### nse2r — archived, under revival

`nse2r` fetched live data from the National Stock Exchange of India. It was
**archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07** at the maintainer's request and is currently
being revived, so it is no longer installable from CRAN.

Source and issue tracker:
[github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r).
:::
